news.title: Hedge funds made $24 billion shorting software stocks so far in 2026 — And they are increasing the bet
news.description: Hedge funds are increasing their short bets against software stocks, contributing to the brutal sell-off in the space so far this year, according to sources at two major funds on Wall Street.

news.title: Oil prices jump after Trump says Iran supreme leader 'should be very worried'
news.description: President Donald Trump has threatened to launch military strikes on Iran if the Islamic Republic doesn't agree to a deal on its nuclear program.

news.title: Fed pick: Tillis doubles down on Warsh blockade over concerns about central bank independence
news.description: Sen. Thom Tillis told CNBC he is committed to blocking Kevin Warsh's confirmation as Fed chair unless the Trump administration ends its probe of Chair Powell.
